audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was a flat "Skill 5/10" on all seven rows while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Xerath, Xerath, Xerath, Xerath, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora.
audit.why: Pre-6 Aurora's only reach is Twofold Hex at 900 and The Weirding at 825 against Xerath's 750/1000/1050, and Across the Veil is a 22-second commitment. From 6 on, Between Worlds is a hop plus a slow zone an immobile Xerath cannot leave.
audit.corrected: Sides set to match the content layer and the packet, with all seven whys rewritten to match the verdict. No win[N] edits — the content layer was already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes described a generic Xerath curve and never named the level-6 flip or the Zhonya's answer.
audit.why: Aurora's spike is Between Worlds at 140/120/100s; Xerath's counter-spike is Zhonya's, not more range.
audit.corrected: Spike prose now names Lost Chapter, the Between Worlds flip, and the Zhonya's partial reclaim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions were absent: Aurora's Between Worlds CC cancels Rite of the Arcane mid-channel, and Spirit Abjuration heals her back through chip so anti-heal timing decides extended trades. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit.
audit.why: Xerath's R is flagged channel (any CC cancels); Aurora's R is hardCC; her passive is flagged heal. Real cooldowns: Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18, Twofold Hex 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, The Weirding 15/14/13/12/11, Between Worlds 140/120/100, Shocking Orb 13/12.5/12/11.5/11.
audit.corrected: R-cancel added to breakdown.mid and the content mid; the passive heal added to breakdown.early; breakdown.cooldowns now carries the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly called her W "Spirit Dash" — no such ability. It is Across the Veil. spikes[2].text also called her E an "exile"; The Weirding is a damage-plus-slow blast with a backward hop.
audit.why: Riot names per the kit file; the packet's suspectNames missed these because the strings are not near-misses.
audit.corrected: Fixed in whys[3], spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, mid and wants.you[1]. dosFull[2].d also called the hop a fifteen-second cooldown — it is 22 down to 18.

audit.whatIsWrong: 21 misgendering defects and two copy-paste-bleed bullets (dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim).
audit.corrected: All flagged fields regendered; both bled bodies replaced with content matching their titles.

edits.before: W joins the pattern: Q-W on the slowed target is the chip combo that defines the next twenty minutes.
edits.after: W's 1000 range joins in: Q-W slows her while Across the Veil is still unlearned at level 2.

edits.before: E completes the kill kit: the stun into full rotation is real damage even now. Hold it for HIS aggression, not yours.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — the artillery goes infinite. Poke the wave contact, the trade attempt, and the recall walk.

edits.before: Rite of the Arcane online — chipped targets anywhere in the lane's zip code are now finishable. Shove and snipe.
edits.after: Between Worlds online: she hops in, drops the zone, and an immobile Xerath cannot walk out of it. Her window opens.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks third-bars. He farms at half HP forever or he doesn't farm.
edits.after: Her first item makes the hop-in combo lethal. Zhonya's is the answer, not more range.

edits.before: Late Xerath wins fights from the next postal code: stun the entry, barrage the objective, and never be seen.
edits.after: Two items and her mobility flanks your line: the R zone holds you still and you have no dash. Ward wide, hug peel.

edits.before: His combo needs proximity your artillery exists to deny — poke the approach, stun the commit, finish by mail.
edits.after: Her burst needs the 700-range hop your artillery denies — poke the approach, stun the commit, finish by mail.

edits.before: Aurora wins by landing Across the Veil (Hop), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Aurora wins by hopping Across the Veil into you and dropping Between Worlds — the zone holds an immobile Xerath still while she bursts.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: Q the last-hit from 750, W her step-up, and walk — Across the Veil is 22 seconds and she has to spend it to answer you at all.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Spending E on chip, then facing the hop into Between Worlds with 11 seconds left on it — Shocking Orb is your only 'no'.

edits.before: Ahead, extend the artillery line: chip Aurora off every CS, R his recalls, and rotate barrages to rivers — a fed Xerath taxes the whole map from fog.

edits.before: - Xerath vs Aurora - Track: Aurora Across the Veil (Hop). - Hold E for his engage — the stun is your entire defense. - Across the Veil (Hop) down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Xerath vs Aurora - Track: Across the Veil, 22s at rank 1. - Hold E for her hop — the stun is your entire defense. - Across the Veil down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.

edits.before: - Aurora Across the Veil (Hop): matchup-defining — Her hop + stealth escape — she is killable only while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shocking Orb for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s — her hop, stealth and escape, and she is killable only while it is down. Twofold Hex is 9s, The Weirding 15s, Between Worlds 140/120/100s. - Budget Shocking Orb (E, 13s) for her hop, never for chip.

edits.before: Open the chip ledger immediately: Q every last-hit, W every dodge, and bank Manaflow — Xerath lanes are won at minute three, collected at minute twenty.
edits.after: Open the chip ledger immediately: Q every last-hit, W her walk-up, and bank Manaflow — Spirit Abjuration heals her back if you let her land spells for free.

edits.before: Post-6 you shove-and-snipe: crash the wave, R the chipped, and rotate your barrage to every river contest — your poke decides objectives you never attend.
edits.after: Post-6 never channel Rite of the Arcane with Between Worlds up — her R cancels it outright. Shove, snipe once she has spent it, and rotate barrages to river.

edits.before: Lost Chapter makes the artillery infinite; level 6 finishes what poke starts; Luden's turns chip into third-bars.

edits.after: Carry by staying outside Between Worlds: 250 range on her R against 5000 on yours, so attend every fight without standing where her hop can land.

edits.before: You are off-screen and decisive: stun the engage, barrage the pit, and re-position before the minimap finds you. Distance is your defense and your damage.
edits.after: Aurora picks the angle, so ward the flanks and hold Zhonya's for the hop — stun her entry, barrage the pit, and never stand alone at the edge of a fight.

notes: Full-layer chart was flat 'Skill 5/10' while content win[0..6] already matched the packet levelChart, so the seven side edits are intentionally unpaired (win[N] edits would be no-ops). The content layer carried a fabricated ability name, 'Spirit Dash', for Across the Veil in five places, and called The Weirding an 'exile'; both corrected. dosFull[2].d described the hop as a fifteen-second cooldown — it is 22/21/20/19/18.
